## What Needs to Change?

Describe the content that needs to be updated.

## Current Content

Paste or describe the existing text/image.

## New Content

Provide the exact replacement text or new asset.

## Location

Which page and section is affected?

- **Page:** e.g. `/about`, `/services`
- **Section:** e.g. "Hero headline", "Project card — Ikorodu Road"

## Additional Notes

Any context on why this change is needed.
